_comment: Per-IP limiting for /api/tutor. This JSON is a re-appliable record of the rule, not something Vercel reads directly — rate-limit rules can't live in vercel.json, so this one is applied via the Vercel Firewall API or the dashboard (Project -> Firewall). Vercel Pro caps rate-limit windows at 10 minutes, hence 600s here rather than something longer.
name: tutor-per-ip
